verification_summary.balance_notes: Bentz has 18 items (7 T1, 11 T3); Beck has 13 (11 T2, 2 T3). Counts and tiers differ because of what exists: Beck's one campaign issues page covers many issues, Bentz has no confirmed campaign site on file so his T1 items come from house.gov and T3 from news. Both were swept on the same list with the same early-stop rule.
